Geopolitical risk and supply concerns lift oil sentiment, yet AI spending worries dampen equities and tech indexes. Inflation data remains a central theme, driving mixed reads on rates and the dollar. The overall market context shows a mixed/neutral global PSI of 46, slight 1% dip, and notable moves in the Fed rate, AUD/USD and USD/JPY, underscoring divergent pressures without clear consensus.
